description: orfi-kit enforcement hooks (OpenAI Codex). Five of the seven shared scripts are wired: PreToolUse/Bash -> orfi-kit-enforce-sync.sh (deny), PostToolUse -> both format verifiers (advisory). The two Stop contracts (enforce-brevity, verify-skill-contract) are deliberately NOT wired: Codex's transcript format is not a stable interface for hooks, and wiring them would produce guardrails that always pass. The two PreToolUse convention loaders are also not wired — plain stdout is ignored by Codex; the conventions arrive declaratively via AGENTS.md instead. Honest gaps, never faked. All scripts live in ~/.claude/hooks (shared single source for all four runtimes) and must run from Git Bash on Windows.
